title: Gate aggregate waiver precedence: per-child conversion then severity reduction

defect_summary.waiver_before_severity: Old logic returned WAIVED whenever every allow-listed FAIL had a waiver, before considering worse remaining children (INCOMPLETE / BLOCKED_EXTERNAL). Example: [FAIL(waivered), INCOMPLETE] incorrectly reduced to WAIVED.
defect_summary.not_per_child: Waivers were evaluated against the whole waivable set, so a single shared waiver appeared to cover multiple failing children.
defect_summary.no_detail: No per-child converted status / waiver justification / positional audit available for evidence.
defect_summary.unused_waiver_maskable: A waiver keyed to a passing position (or a non-existent name) silently did nothing; no isolation guarantee against waiving the wrong child.

corrected_semantics.conversion: Each child is converted individually: PASS->PASS, FAIL->WAIVED only when waivable_fail and allow-listed and an explicit governed waiver names that exact child, else FAIL; INCOMPLETE/NOT_RUN/BLOCKED_EXTERNAL are never convertible by a waiver; unknown values -> INCOMPLETE (fail-closed).
corrected_semantics.reduction: Aggregate = worst of converted statuses under FAIL > INCOMPLETE > BLOCKED_EXTERNAL > WAIVED > NOT_RUN > PASS.
corrected_semantics.single_use_waivers: One failing child per waiver; multiple failing children require per-child coverage.
corrected_semantics.audit: promote_aggregate_detailed returns per-child rows (input, name, status, waiver, coerced_from), positional_audit (overflow_names, collisions, ambiguous), unused_waiver_keys.
corrected_semantics.evolving_api: child_names optional strict binding (validated for length/duplicates); positional mandatory_children alignment preserved as legacy fallback.

previous_vs_corrected_3.note: unchanged result but now provably isolated: waiver for a passing position can never waive the failing sibling

coverage.A: uncorrupted pass chain and per-child conversion preservation
coverage.B: severity reduction after per-child conversion (waived+incomplete->incomplete; blocked_external outranks waived)
coverage.C: waivable FAIL with explicit governed waiver -> WAIVED
coverage.D: unwaivable FAIL remains FAIL (no waiver / off allow-list / waivable_fail=False)
coverage.E: waivers never convert INCOMPLETE / NOT_RUN / BLOCKED_EXTERNAL to WAIVED
coverage.F: waivers are single-use; partial coverage stays FAIL; full coverage -> WAIVED
coverage.G: ungoverned/unknown values coerce to INCOMPLETE (never PASS)
coverage.H: aggregate is never PASS while any child is non-PASS
coverage.I: name-only waiver with no failing child does nothing (reported as unused)
coverage.J: positional/label mismatch isolation (waiver can never waive the wrong child)
coverage.L: named-child ordering divergence audit, duplicate-name rejection, positional audit, empty children -> INCOMPLETE

residual_risks: There are currently zero call sites of promote_aggregate / promote_aggregate_detailed in the repository; the corrected semantics and report surface are therefore exercised only by contract tests until OC-36 (QualityGateManager) and other gate consumers adopt them.

WAIVED outranks NOT_RUN in the mandated severity order (FAIL > INCOMPLETE > BLOCKED_EXTERNAL > WAIVED > NOT_RUN > PASS); a never-run (NOT_RUN) child can therefore be masked by a governed waiver. This is the declared ordering and should not be silently changed.
